note: The two sets are nearly identical in content and share the same substantive errors: both bind the row "CU: #12/2WG." to Wiring 151 when the schedule shows that description belongs to symbol 10 (151 is "AL: 3#4/0, ARMORED CABLE"), both leave the "AL: 3#4/0, #4G., 2-1/2"C." row under the vague entity "cable" instead of Wiring 150, and both use the 151 row text as the quote for the Wiring 150 material claim. The only real difference is that A states the Wiring 150 attribute as the vague "material" while B correctly says "conductor material", so B is marginally more precise. Both sets also omit the Wiring 10 row, the 151/150 conductor and conduit details, and all the panel/breaker notes.
remarks: Both extractions appear to come from the same pipeline with only an attribute-label difference; the shared misbinding of "CU: #12/2WG." to mark 151 (it is mark 10 in the schedule) and the shared misquote for the Wiring 150 material claim suggest a row-alignment bug in the wiring-schedule parsing. Both also miss the NOTES content (150A/2P main breaker, main bonding jumper, 200A/2P NFDS NEMA 3R, 4 AWG copper to gnd, L1/L2 & N no gnd) and the 2-1/2"C. conduit on row 150.
